_doctor_check_helper() {
	local version
	if ! version=$("$HELPER_BIN" --version 2>/dev/null); then
		_fail "helper does not run: $HELPER_BIN"
		return
	fi
	if [[ ! $version =~ ^wispr-flow-linux-helper\ [0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
		_fail "unexpected helper version: $version"
		return
	fi
	_pass "helper: $version"
}
